name: Grace Antony
bio: Grace Antony is an Indian film actress, model and classical dancer who works in the Malayalam film industry.

credits.title: Avaraachan & Sons
credits.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

credits.title: Patriot
credits.overview: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

credits.title: Parandhu Po
credits.overview: Gokul’s financial reach far exceeds his reality, but juggling unpayable loans and dodging debt collectors, he tries his best to provide for his pampered son, Anbu. credits.title: ED: Extra Decent
credits.overview: A controlling son's family try to prevent him from regaining his memory after he is hospitalised following a blow to the head.

credits.title: Nunakkuzhi
credits.overview: Eby, an immature managing director desperately trying to retrieve his laptop from an income tax officer, finds himself caught in a web of deceit and his stupid decisions only lead him deeper into trouble.

credits.title: Vivekanandan Viralanu
credits.overview: A seemingly normal person's dual life is upended when he becomes infamous overnight. He struggles to reconcile his new public persona with his true self.

credits.title: Padachone Ingalu Kaatholee
credits.overview: Dineshan, Grace, Giri, KK and Gund Saji are involved in leftwing politics. Dineshan gets attracted to a girl who stays over at his house and she makes him consider all the occurrences that happen at home and take action for them.

credits.title: Saturday Night
credits.overview: The film centers around a group of four childhood friends, Stanley, Sunil, Babu, and Ravi. After a long separation, they reunite and embark on a journey to rekindle their bond.

credits.title: Appan
credits.overview: A cruel womaniser, who cheated death and has been bedridden for ages, harasses his wife and son out of spite. As his family waits for him to die, the villagers form a mob demanding to kill him because of his actions. credits.title: Rorschach
credits.overview: When Luke Antony's wife goes missing, he sets off to search for her and stumbles upon the Balan family. However, terrorising events start occurring as Luke grows closer to them.

credits.title: Chattambi
credits.overview: Set in 1995, Chattambi follows the lives of abrasive outlaws in rural Idukki. When Kariah feels he is being excluded from the clan, he decides to lead his life on his own terms without realizing the grave consequences of his decision.

credits.title: Pathrosinte Padappukal
credits.overview: Pathrose is a gas agency employee whose family includes his wife and his four children. The central character in the film is his second son Tony, who lives happily without doing any work. The story revolves around Tony's grandmother who comes in between them and the interesting events that follow.

credits.title: Kanakam Kaamini Kalaham
credits.overview: As Pavithran and Haripriya's marriage withers away, he plans a trip to bring things back on track. But his marital bliss is threatened by a bunch of nutjobs.

credits.title: Saajan Bakery Since 1962
credits.overview: Siblings Bobbin and Betsy run their family business, Saajan Bakery, together. However, their equation is a turbulent one with their aims in life poles apart. The rivalry and the ensuing events form the film’s plot.

credits.title: Halal Love Story
credits.overview: A group of friends attempts to make a 'halal' film that conforms to the guidelines and descriptions of an Islamic organization which they are a part of.

credits.title: Prathi Poovankozhi
credits.overview: Madhuri is assaulted on a bus one day and won't rest till she hits back at the man

credits.title: Thamasha
credits.overview: Sreenivasan, a bald 31-year-old, finds it tough to get a girl to like or marry him. Will lady love ever bless him?

credits.title: Kumbalangi Nights
credits.overview: Four brothers living in the fishing hamlet of Kumbalangi share a love-hate relationship with each other. Their relationship progresses when Saji, Boney and Franky decide to help Bobby stand by his love.

credits.title: Sakalakalashala
credits.overview: Akbar studies in an engineering college and is a brilliant student. He makes everyone proud when he wins the first prize in a tech fest. However, things take a turn when one of his technical innovation backfires and leaves him into serious trouble. Will Akbar be able to overcome this problem?

credits.title: Kaaliyan
credits.overview: Kaaliyan is a Malayalam movie starring Tini Tom in prominent roles. It is an action drama directed by Jijo Pangode.

credits.title: Match Box
credits.overview: Ambu, a college student, develops romantic feelings for a woman he sees at a bus stop. However, things get complicated before he can profess his love to her.

credits.title: Lakshyam
credits.overview: Vimal Kumar, a murder convict and Mustafa, a petty thief escape the clutches of police when the vehicle transporting them to jail meets with an accident. The duo, who get trapped in a forest, gradually get talking and discover more about each other and the way forward. What's awaiting them… handcuffs or a good future?

credits.title: Georgettan's Pooram
credits.overview: George Vadakkan is the quintessential prodigal son of a priest, who wished he followed the father’s path. His friends and George generally hang out at Mathayi Parambu, a public playground cum hangout space of the area. How the park plays a part in setting his life straight is the core of the pooram.

credits.title: Kamboji
credits.overview: An extremely passionate kathakali artiste falls in love with a mohiniyattam artiste and their blossoming affair gives rise to a new and unique form of art.

credits.title: Happy Wedding
credits.overview: The story of an engineering graduate Hari, as he contemplates marriage on his mother's insistence.
